selection_rationale: Stage boxes most often met behind the consoles used in French venues and schools (Yamaha CL/QL/TF, Allen & Heath Qu/SQ/dLive, Midas/Behringer M32/X32, DiGiCo SD), one passive analog multipin snake, and one or two reference devices per transport: Dante (Focusrite RedNet, Audinate AVIO), AVB/Milan (d&b DS20), MADI (RME M-32 AD, DiGiCo SD-Rack), AES50 (Midas DL16), bridges (d&b DS10, DirectOut PRODIGY.MC, AVIO AES3) and AoIP switches (Luminex, NETGEAR). Candidates that could not be reached without web search (Klark Teknik DN9650, Yamaha SWP1, Behringer S16) were dropped rather than entered unsourced.

devices.why_it_is_a_classic: Audinate's own low-cost way to put any analog line source (wireless receiver, small mixer, DI) on a Dante network; ubiquitous in kit bags according to Audinate's positioning of the AVIO range for live use.

devices.notes: Line level only: the datasheet lists selectable maximum levels down to -10dBV and no phantom power, so it is not a mic preamp.
